title: BEST BEAUTY BOX SUBSCRIPTION!!!!
text: I just received my 1st Allure Beauty box today..it was in a pretty white box & all of the items were covered in a pretty red tissue..I loved every single item!! I've subscribed to quite a few beauty boxes in the past & I have to say, this 1 is THE BEST...I love ALL of the products so far, and I have used them all in the past.  Plus , I love knowing this comes to me SAFELY through Amazon & if anything ever goes wrong with my subscription, they will make it right!!!!
label: positive
